summary: Implemented CAP-4 card detail with title edit, replace, re-crop, confirmed delete, persisted crop/rotation, transactional attachment replacement, 13 component/route tests, 2 data replacement tests, and a real-PNG Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented CAP-4 card detail with title edit, replace, re-crop, confirmed delete, persisted crop/rotation, transactional attachment replacement, 13 component/route tests, 2 data replacement tests, and a real-PNG Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.
decisions: Card crop, rotation, and full-resolution preference are optional persisted card fields; card import now forwards the processed values so re-crop survives reload.

Replacement writes the new original/display/thumbnail and card metadata in one transaction, then removes previous attachment rows after commit; cleanup failure is reported without discarding the new image.
Replace photo processes a newly selected file as full-frame upright; Crop/rotate regenerates derivatives from the retained original using the stored crop and rotation.
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/capture.spec.ts: 3 passed at desktop, tablet-landscape, phone
warnings: The case board is still the foundation placeholder; card tap-through must be wired by board-engineer. The route and full capture-to-detail journey are verified.
Playwright evidence uses Chromium-based projects only; Firefox/WebKit card-detail behavior is not covered by this task.
A post-commit cleanup failure can leave unreferenced old attachment rows while reporting cleanupPending; the normal path leaves exactly three current rows.
docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl has a pre-existing engine-generated modification that was not authored or touched.
validationLimitations: Browser rotation/crop behavior was verified in Chromium only.
The replacement cleanupPending failure branch is handled and typed but not exercised in the browser journey.
payload.taskDescription: Create CardDetailPage at /case/:caseId/card/:cardId showing the display image, type, title, tags slot, and actions Edit title, Replace photo, Crop/rotate, and Delete card. Replacing or re-cropping runs the image pipeline from the retained original and preserves the card ID; remove old attachments only after the new transaction succeeds. Add a Playwright journey that creates a case, imports e2e/fixtures/note.png through the native file input, rotates and crops, saves, reloads, opens card detail, edits the title, replaces the photo with e2e/fixtures/source.png, and verifies the card ID and both images after reload. Do not add OCR or connection actions.
